messages.subject: Draft letter before action — Ferncliffe
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Draft LBA attached for your review before it goes out. It sets out the contract, the non-conformity, breach and an outline of loss (>£2.9m), invites an admission within 14 days and asks them to preserve documents. I've kept the quantum at outline level and reserved the detailed schedule for the Particulars.

James

Dear Sirs,

Please find attached our letter before claim on behalf of Halstead Aerospace Limited in respect of the supply of non-conforming Ti-6Al-4V bar. A response is requested within 14 days as set out in the letter. A hard copy follows by post.

Yours faithfully,
James Osei
Whitfield Carter LLP
